name: Semiconductor Microelectronics
description: Review of quantum mechanics; crystal structure: Miller indices, reciprocal lattice; electron in a periodic lattice: Bloch theorem and crystal momentum, E-k diagram, tight binding method, spin orbit coupling; density of states, Fermi-Dirac distribution, intrinsic carrier, doping; Boltzmann transport equation and solution in the presence of low electric and magnetic fields - mobility and diffusivity; scattering effects; continuity equation, Poisson's equation and their solution; high field effects: velocity saturation, hot carriers and avalanche breakdown; semiconductor junctions: metal-semiconductor, semiconductor homo- and hetero-junction band diagrams and I-V characteristics, and small signal switching models; two terminal and surface states devices based on semiconductor junctions; MOS capacitor: depletion, inversion, accumulation modes. Flatband conditions, CV characteristics - high and low frequencies. Impact of non-idealities on MOS capacitor characteristics – effect of traps, fixed charges and tunnelling; MOSFET: ideal operation and non-idealities – channel length modulation, subthreshold swing, DIBL, velocity saturation and reliability issues in MOSFETs. Modern MOSFETS: FinFETS, strained silicon devices etc.
